cli.main.notwired.suffix: {feature} is not wired to a real implementation yet (wiring happens after the corresponding WP merges).
cli.main.error.install_not_ready: Manifest is not ready to install (still has TBD/unapproved fields).
cli.main.error.install_m2_blocked: Real installation is in M2 scope (BLOCKED on this host); M1 only supports plan-install/dry-run.
cli.main.error.evidence_load_failed: Could not load the evidence report.
cli.main.error.service_catalog_broken: Could not read the service directory (data bundled with the repo is corrupted).
cli.main.warning.never_usable: '{id}': status '{status}' does NOT mean usable (GATE ECO-003) — it is only downloadable or launchable so far, the workflow has not been confirmed complete.
cli.main.warning.listed_vs_working: The directory lists {listed} services; ONLY {working} of them are workflow_verified (actual submit/receive confirmed) — the listed count does NOT mean the usable count (ECO-022).
cli.main.error.service_not_found: No service found with id '{id}' in the directory.
cli.main.error.internal_unknown: Unknown internal error while processing the command.
eco.status.reason.not_inventoried: No step has run yet (all not_run) — not surveyed yet.
eco.status.reason.discover_failed: The discover step failed — the official source could not be found/no longer exists.
eco.status.reason.acquire_failed: The acquire step actually failed (not blocked externally).
eco.status.reason.install_failed: The install_or_open step actually failed (install/open did not succeed).
eco.status.reason.step_blocked: Step '{step}' is blocked by an external dependency (e.g. missing connectivity/sandbox/permission/token) — ECO-016.
eco.status.reason.downloadable_only: Only the source has been fetched/reached so far (acquire pass) — install/open has not been confirmed (install_or_open not pass yet). GATE: this status must NOT be shown as usable.
eco.status.reason.launches_only: Install/open succeeded (install_or_open) but login/the next task has not been tried yet. GATE: this status must NOT be shown as usable.
eco.status.reason.partial_pending_submit: Passed authenticate/execute but has not reached submit_or_export/verify_result yet.
eco.status.reason.workflow_verified: submit_or_export + verify_result both pass and have a real evidence_ref.
eco.status.reason.partial_missing_eviden: submit_or_export/verify_result pass but evidence_ref is MISSING at: {missing} — GATE ECO-003 does not allow workflow_verified without real submit/receive evidence.
eco.status.reason.partial_unclear: The combination of results does not match any other clear branch (e.g. verify_result not_applicable) — kept as partial_workflow to stay safe, not auto-promoted to workflow_verified when not certain.
eco.workflow.error.step_unknown_or_dupli: Step '{name}' is invalid or duplicated at position {idx}.
eco.workflow.error.step_missing: Missing required step '{name}' — the 7-step model MUST keep all 7 steps even when the outcome is not_applicable (ECO-001), none may be removed.
eco.workflow.error.step_order: The step order must exactly match {order}.
eco.workflow.error.acquire_method_invali: Web software without an installer must NOT be marked acquire.method='downloaded_binary' (ECO-001).
eco.workflow.error.install_method_invali: Web software without an installer: a passing install_or_open MUST have method='{method}' (opening the correct official URL in a browser).
eco.validator.error.url_scheme_invalid: '{path}' must use the http or https scheme, not an unknown scheme ('{scheme}').
eco.validator.error.url_embedded_credent: '{path}' embeds credentials in the URL ('user@host') — a sign of domain spoofing, it must NOT be treated as an official source.
eco.validator.error.usability_claim_forb: Status '{status}' must ABSOLUTELY NOT be marked usable (GATE ECO-003) — regardless of the calling context.
eco.validator.error.status_evidence_miss: Cannot set published_status='workflow_verified': the 7-step data only proves '{derived_status}'. Reason: {reasons}
eco.validator.error.status_transition_in: published_status cannot move from '{from_status}' to '{to_status}' — valid targets: {allowed}.
eco.validator.error.executable_key_forbi: Field '{key}' is absolutely forbidden in the ECO-006 catalog — the directory must NEVER control commands/execution.
eco.validator.error.official_claim_forbi: '{path}' contains a forbidden phrase (implying NaMi owns/officializes a third-party product) — ECO-007 forbids this absolutely.
eco.catalog_schema.error.string_length: '{path}' must be a string of 1..{max_len} characters.
eco.catalog_schema.error.string_length_n: '{path}' must be a string of 1..{max_len} characters or null.
eco.catalog_schema.error.array_item_leng: '{item_path}' must be a string of 1..{item_max_len} characters.
eco.catalog_schema.error.unknown_propert: Unknown property '{key}' — the ECO-006 directory has NO execution/command field at all; only declared metadata fields are allowed.
eco.catalog_schema.error.entry_must_be_o: A service-catalog entry must be a JSON object.
eco.catalog_schema.error.id_pattern_inva: 'id' must match the lowercase/digit/.- pattern and be at most 100 characters.
eco.catalog_schema.error.official_url_in: 'official_url' must be a valid http(s):// string, at most 2048 characters.
eco.catalog_schema.error.last_updated_in: 'last_updated' must be a date in "YYYY-MM-DD" form.
